summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.32/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.32 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 24, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 4¢ higher than a week ago, 46¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.51 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Madison ($4.17) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.49).
